strongest_bounded_proposition: Precontact Mesoamerica included enslavement, but this packet does not establish slavery for the sampled Maya city-state target at c. 500 CE.
strongest_unsupported_proposition: Do not convert captive imagery, warfare, sacrifice, or general Mesoamerican enslavement into an anchor-year Maya slavery claim.
terminology_category_qualification: Captivity, sacrifice, dependency and slavery remain distinct.
temporal_scope_precision: Strong Maya captive evidence consulted is later than 500.
inference_extent: No inference beyond stated target/evidence locus.
language_access_limitations: English-accessible packet only; non-English/non-digitized scholarship not exhaustively searched.
